description: Kitchen remodeling budget split by line item with sales tax, contingency reserve and permit allowance; libraries for npm, PyPI, crates.io, pub.dev, NuGet, RubyGems and Packagist.
rules: Money is computed in integer cents; round(x) = floor(x + 0.5).
Split mode treats the amount as all-in (tax, reserve and permit included); estimate mode adds them on top.
Default sales tax is 10.3% (Bellevue, WA, Oct to Dec 2026) and default reserve is 10%; both are options.
